issue_title: Support partial profile updates with PATCH
issue_body:
Clients must send the whole profile today to change one field.

Add `PATCH /profiles/{id}` taking a JSON merge-patch body over `display_name`, `bio`, `avatar_url` and `timezone`. A field set to a value replaces the stored value. A field set to `null` clears it. A field left out of the body is left unchanged. `display_name` cannot be cleared: `{"display_name": null}` returns `422` with error code `display_name_required`. Only the profile's owner may PATCH it; anyone else gets `403`.

plan.summary: Add PATCH /profiles/{id} with merge-patch updates of the four profile fields.

approach.description: Decode the PATCH body into a ProfilePatch struct whose four fields are *string.
Reject a null display_name with 422 and error code display_name_required, and a caller other than the owner with 403.
Add UpdateProfile to internal/store/profiles.go, writing all four columns from the ProfilePatch in one UPDATE.
Document PATCH /profiles/{id} and the display_name_required error in api/openapi.yaml.

verification.test_strategy: Handler tests send each body shape (a value, a null, a body without the field) and read the profile back; the 422 and 403 cases assert the status and the error code.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR; the endpoint is additive and no migration runs.

acceptance_criteria.statement: PATCH /profiles/{id} with {"bio": "hello"} returns HTTP 200 and stores bio "hello".
PATCH /profiles/{id} with {"timezone": null} returns HTTP 200 and clears the stored timezone.
A PATCH /profiles/{id} body with no bio key returns HTTP 200 and applies the fields the body carries.
acceptance_criteria.verify_hint: Set bio to "hello", PATCH /profiles/u1 with {"timezone": "UTC"}, then read the profile back: timezone is "UTC" and bio is null.

acceptance_criteria.statement: PATCH /profiles/{id} with {"display_name": null} returns HTTP 422 with error code display_name_required.
PATCH /profiles/{id} by a caller who does not own the profile returns HTTP 403.

risks_and_assumptions: Profiles have exactly the four writable fields the issue lists.

catch_probes: cannot fail against the plan's defect
an existing bio keeps that exact value
expects the bio to be null

catching_examples.note: ac-patch-no-bio-key's verify_hint contradicts the issue: a field left out of the merge-patch body is left unchanged and only a null clears it, so after a body without bio the bio should stay "hello", not read back as null.

ac-patch-no-bio-key conflates absent and null in its verify_hint: it expects the bio to be null after a PATCH that sets only timezone, while the issue keeps the stored bio. Approach step 1's *string fields cannot distinguish a missing key from a null either.
The statement for a body with no bio key reads fine, but its hint expects the bio cleared; the issue requires the opposite: an existing bio keeps that exact value.

Criterion ac-patch-no-bio-key is weaker than the issue as stated and wrong in its verify_hint: the issue says a field left out of the body is left unchanged, yet the hint reads bio back as null. Approach step 3 writes all four columns, so the implementation would clear the bio too. Expect the stored bio to be unchanged, and decode into a structure that tells a missing key from a null.
ac-patch-no-bio-key does not match the issue: as written it is not falsifiable and cannot fail against the plan's defect; it should require the stored bio to be unchanged.
ac-patch-no-bio-key is vacuous against approach step 3: nothing in it checks that the bio is left unchanged.
The criterion on a PATCH body with no bio does not match the issue: its hint expects the bio cleared, but an omitted field keeps its stored value.

non_catching_examples.note: ac-patch-no-bio-key needs a test that reads the profile back after the PATCH and asserts the stored bio.
No test sends a PATCH body that is not valid JSON; it should return 400.
ac-patch-no-bio-key is ambiguous about the Content-Type: application/json versus application/merge-patch+json is a mismatch the handler may refuse as unsupported.
Writing all four columns in one UPDATE races with a concurrent PATCH from another session; add an updated_at precondition.
ac-patch-null-clears-timezone: a field set to null clears it; add the same test for avatar_url.
Document PATCH /profiles/{id} and the display_name_required error in api/openapi.yaml.
ac-patch-no-bio-key: add a sibling test that a {"bio": null} body clears the bio.
